title: Ông bà chăm cháu · Problems / Solutions
prompt: Some societies are considering providing financial support to grandparents who regularly care for grandchildren. What problems could this create, and what measures could be taken to address them?
instructions: Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience. Write at least 250 words.

Chăm cháu đều đặn làm ông bà phát sinh chi và có thể giảm việc có lương. Trợ cấp ghi nhận chi phí chăm sóc thực, không phải trả thưởng vì có quan hệ gia đình.

grammar.example: Overall, support should be judged by voluntary participation and sustainable care arrangements, while retaining formal childcare options for families whose older relatives cannot or do not wish to help.
grammar.why: Trong câu “Overall, support should be judged by voluntary participation and sustainable care arrangements, while retaining formal childcare options for families whose older relatives cannot or do not wish to help.”, while nối hai diễn biến hoặc yêu cầu cần xét cùng nhau; ở đây phải giữ cả hai phía để không biến điều kiện giới hạn thành phủ nhận toàn bộ lợi ích. Không giả định mọi ông bà muốn hoặc đủ sức chăm cháu. Trợ cấp có thể thành áp lực đạo đức buộc nhận vai trò; lợi ích tài chính chưa đo đủ quyền tự chủ.

paragraphs: Grandparents often subsidise family childcare through their own time, travel and household spending. Payments can turn voluntary grandparent care into an expected duty, making genuine consent and continued access to formal childcare essential safeguards.

Payments may reinforce an expectation that older relatives should sacrifice their own plans. Once an allowance exists, relatives may interpret it as payment for expected availability rather than recognition of voluntary help. Grandparents can then face pressure to reduce their own work, rest or social plans, even where the sum does not cover the full personal cost. An allowance can cover genuine expenses, but it may undermine autonomy if families begin to treat grandparents' availability as an obligation purchased by the payment. A grandparent may accept the arrangement to avoid disappointing an adult child even when declining health makes several full days of care exhausting. The existence of a payment can make refusing harder, especially if the family has already cancelled a nursery place in expectation of continuing help.

Support should be voluntary and preserve access to formal childcare alternatives. Voluntary eligibility and access to formal alternatives reduce pressure to accept caring duties, protecting the grandparent's time, health and plans as well as family income. An allowance should stop when a grandparent chooses to reduce care, without penalising the household through loss of access to nursery places or other ordinary childcare assistance. Eligibility should consequently allow carers to change their hours and withdraw voluntarily, with formal childcare still accessible so that protecting an older relative's health does not leave parents without any workable arrangement.

Overall, support should be judged by voluntary participation and sustainable care arrangements, while retaining formal childcare options for families whose older relatives cannot or do not wish to help.

paragraphs.quote: Support should be voluntary and preserve access to formal childcare alternatives. Voluntary eligibility and access to formal alternatives reduce pressure to accept caring duties, protecting the grandparent's time, health and plans as well as family income. An allowance should stop when a grandparent chooses to reduce care, without penalising the household through loss of access to nursery places or other ordinary childcare assistance. Eligibility should consequently allow carers to change their hours and withdraw voluntarily, with formal childcare still accessible so that protecting an older relative's health does not leave parents without any workable arrangement.
paragraphs.why: Tự nguyện và lựa chọn nhà trẻ giúp ông bà có thể từ chối. Nếu cắt dịch vụ chính thức rồi trả ít tiền, gia đình bị đẩy vào chăm sóc không lương thay vì được mở thêm lựa chọn.
